texts.preamble: Mangilal Savita vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 October, 2024 Author: Sunita Yadav Bench: Sunita Yadav 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Gwalior Crr No. 5108 of 2023 (Mangilal Savita Vs The State Of Madhya Dated : 16-10-2024 Mr. Ram Kishor Sharma - Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Saket Naresh Udainiya - P.P. for respondent/State.
texts.arguments: Counsel for the petitioner submitted that petitioner is suffering from heart ailment for long period of time, under these circumstances, he may be exempted from surrender before the learned trial Court. Learned counsel for the petitioner argued that the Courts below have wrongly appreciated the evidence and convicted the petitioner. It is further submitted that there are material contradictions and omissions in the statement of prosecution witnesses.
